svg.desc: Chapter seven, credits. PLAYER 2 WANTED: Jiteesh is looking for a software engineering internship. Insert coin by opening an issue on this repository, or link up on LinkedIn. End credits roll beside it and the card ends on THANKS FOR PLAYING.
